meta.description: Retention visibility lane — DRY-RUN ONLY. A Schedule Trigger calls the `lanes` service (GET lanes:8081/retention, header x-lanes-token), which runs scripts/retention_sweep.py WITHOUT --apply and returns the report. The endpoint has no apply parameter at all, so this lane cannot delete a file or prune the vault however it is called — enforced as a capability, not a setting. The PII token vault is deliberately NOT mounted into `lanes` (the vault never leaves the scrubber), so vault pruning is NOT inspected and the message says so; the raw report's '0 vault entries prunable' line must not be read as a finding. Actually enforcing retention stays a human-invoked action on the host. n8n keeps the schedule, execution log and Notify seam — see docs/decisions/0006. Deploy with scripts/n8n_bootstrap.py.
